issues.legal_issue: Arrears for a rent-demand eviction ground are limited to rent due when the demand notice is served and do not include rent accruing afterward.
material_facts: Rent was payable in advance, and rent for two months was due when the landlady served a demand notice.
The tenant tendered two bank drafts representing the two months of rent demanded, both within two months of service of the notice.
A further month's rent fell due after service of the notice, but the tenant did not tender it within that period.
The landlady neither encashed nor returned the drafts.
issues.conclusion: The arrears covered by the notice did not include rent falling due after service of the notice. Because the tenant tendered the arrears demanded within two months, the non-payment ground was not established, and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 14(1)(a) of the Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958, the relevant arrears are those demanded by the notice; rent falling due after service of the notice is not added to them. The Court approved the High Court’s application of that interpretation and overruled the contrary views in Jag Ram Nathu Ram v. Shri Surinder Kumar and S.L. Kapur v. Dr. Mrs. P.D. Lal.

rule.if: rent_nonpayment_eviction_proceeding and demand_notice_identified_arrears and demanded_arrears_tendered_within_two_months and post_notice_rent_fell_due

predicates.rent_nonpayment_eviction_proceeding: A landlord pursued eviction on the ground that the tenant had not paid or tendered rent after receiving a demand notice.
predicates.demand_notice_identified_arrears: The landlord's notice specified rent already due when the notice was served.
predicates.demanded_arrears_tendered_within_two_mon: The tenant tendered the rent demanded by the notice within two months of receiving it.
predicates.post_notice_rent_fell_due: Additional rent became due after the demand notice was served.

issues.definition: When a landlord pursues eviction for non-payment, the tenant tenders the arrears identified in the notice within two months, and further rent falls due after service, that later rent is excluded and the non-payment ground is not established.
